original.target_description: Original full text not acquired through bounded open-access routes; replication treated independently.

replication.target_description: Experiment 3 replication, Response × Accuracy × Proportion interaction in remember judgments

n.exclusions: 15 of 48 excluded for absent correct/incorrect response cells; 13 neutral and 20 conflicting proportion.
n.quote: Because participants who made no incorrect or no correct responses for a particular item had to be excluded, 33 participants were included in this analysis.

es.quote: The three-way interaction between response, accuracy, and proportion was not significant F(1, 31) = .384 , p = .54.

p.quote: The three-way interaction between response, accuracy, and proportion was not significant F(1, 31) = .384 , p = .54.

reported_success.quote: The present replication failed to reproduce Dodson et al’s finding of a significant 2 (response: stereotype consistent vs. stereotype inconsistent) x 2 (accuracy: correct vs. incorrect) x 2 (proportion: neutral vs. conflicting) interaction.
